info.name: AlikoHub Foundation API
info.description:
Backend API for AlikoHub Foundation (Express + Sequelize + MySQL).

## For frontend teammate (integration only)
1. Backend running: `cd backend && npm run dev`
2. Import this collection into Postman
3. `baseUrl` = `http://localhost:4000` (or deployed URL)
4. Public CMS needs NO token
5. Admin routes: run Auth → Login first (saves `{{token}}`)

## Admin login (seeded)
- email: `admin@alikohub.com`
- password: `Admin@12345`

## Frontend page → public endpoint map
| Page | Endpoint |
|---|---|
| Governance (board) | `GET /api/public/board` |
| Governance (staff) | `GET /api/public/staff` |
| Stories | `GET /api/public/stories` |
| Insights | `GET /api/public/insights` |
| Resources | `GET /api/public/resources` |
| FAQ | `GET /api/public/faqs` |
| Programs | `GET /api/public/programs` |
| Services | `GET /api/public/services` |

## Board & Staff (IMPORTANT)
- There is NO Team model anymore.
- Use separate models/endpoints: **Board** and **Staff**.
- Photos live on each person as `imageUrl`.

## Images
- No standalone Image API.
- `Board.imageUrl` / `Staff.imageUrl` / `Story.imageUrl` / `Program.imageUrl` / `Service.imageUrl`
- Upload via Admin Media, then paste `{{baseUrl}}/uploads/<filename>` into `imageUrl`

## Story types
- `story` | `insight`

## Resource categories
- `briefs` | `evidence` | `curricula` | `policies`

## FAQ categories
- `About` | `Support` | `Accountability` | `Contact`

## Response shape
- List: `{ "data": [ ... ] }`
- One: `{ "data": { ... } }`

## Seeds
- `npm run db:seed:admin`
- `npm run db:seed:board`
- `npm run db:seed:staff`
- `npm run db:seed:stories`
- `npm run db:seed:resources`
- `npm run db:seed:faqs`

## Notes
- JSON bodies use camelCase
- No claim-first-admin API
- Newsletter: `POST /api/subscribers`
- Media upload form-data field name: `file`
